form.title: Your details
form.description: Amounts are in South African rand (ZAR).

amount.label: Loan amount
amount.sliderHint: Drag to set the amount. The field above updates to match.

term.label: Repayment term
term.hint: The number of months over which you would repay the loan.

interestRate.note: Uses a fixed illustrative interest rate of {{rate}}% per year.
interestRate.tooltipContent: The interest rate is the yearly cost of borrowing. The estimate keeps it fixed for the whole term.

resetDialog.title: Reset the form?
resetDialog.description: This clears every value and removes the current estimate. It cannot be undone.
